author: BigVikDada
text: VOLTA-AUTODOXER is a self-deleting Windows infostealer that harvests browser passwords, cookies, Microsoft OAuth tokens, SSH and cloud keys, crypto wallet seeds, and screenshots, then uses an LLM to triage the haul.

author: AntonPincu56792
text: GPT-5.4 discovered a Telegram vulnerability that could allow hackers to take over a phone with just one call, reported by NebuSec. Telegram's Android app versions prior to 12.10.4 contained a bug in in-call control messages.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Three chained Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days (CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527) exploited in the wild since October 3, granting unauthenticated root access. All three are now in CISA KEV. Patches exist for all three as of October 29.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: IBM says critical Langflow flaws affect versions 1.0.0-1.12.8 and may enable authentication bypass or remote code execution. Version 1.13.0 fixes them; a Metasploit module for CVE-2026-93680 lists MCP tools but does not execute code.

author: Nishantk1906
text: CVE-2026-98432 critical Linux kernel bug (CVSS 9.8): remote unauthenticated attackers can crash servers, leak kernel memory, or get RCE via a use-after-free in IPv4 TCP handshake code. Affects virtually every Linux kernel since 4.4. Worst on systems with MPTCP listeners.

author: PiEDawg_
text: Arkham Intelligence tracked 36 addresses tied to the Mercado Bitcoin breach holding ~$46M in assets; Brazil's largest exchange halted withdrawals; platform reports no customer losses.

author: TheCyberSecHub
text: Fintech platform Sageworks taken offline after suspected cyberattack (BleepingComputer).

author: emits_ca
text: PAN-OS zero-day CVE-2026-0322 (8.6): exploited in the wild, lets an attacker with management-interface access run commands as root on the firewall. Restrict that interface to trusted IPs and patch.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: Noma Labs' SneakPeek: Claude Code Desktop's preview pane was a local file reader, and the first fix was bypassed.

author: EnclaveRadar
text: Public exploit released: CVE-2026-103409 (CVSS 9.8) Session Smart Router: An attacker obtains administrative privileges when an unauthenticated internal endpoint is accessed. Remote, no login needed.

author: DefusedCyber
text: We are observing in-the-wild exploitation attempts against CVE-2026-81648, a critical (CVSS 10.0) flaw in the CryptoPayment Gateway for WordPress. There's been no prior public report of this vulnerability being exploited in the wild.

author: utkarshships
text: Anthropic says Claude wrote a working remote root exploit for a Linux kernel bug that's been there since Linux 4.4. ~48 minutes to leak a kernel address, 5 more minutes to run commands as root. Fix committed upstream Oct 5; distros still lagging.

author: cubillas888
text: Infostealer with an AI analyst: Talos says VOLTA sends stolen data to an LLM that ranks the victim's assets by value. Its haul includes browser sessions, OAuth tokens and cloud keys. After an infection, revoke sessions and rotate keys too.

author: myAlerts_in
text: AU Small Finance Bank detected a potential data breach on 29 Oct involving a third-party SaaS platform used for onboarding vehicle loan customers.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: Cursor says a malicious, non-Anthropic Claude Code extension build (2.1.312, 2.1.313) sat in its marketplace about 11 hours on Oct 29. Check ~/.ssh/authorized_keys for a key labeled svc-telemetry. If found, isolate the host and rotate credentials.

author: DarkWebInformer
text:
🚨 More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited RCE flaw; CVE-2026-97229

The CVSS 10.0 vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code through a malicious regular expression inside a CI/CD configuration.
⠀
• CVSS: 10.0
• https://t.co/sVdyPEe5mZ

author: psoheil
text: Critical UEFI firmware vulnerability CVE-2026-97631 in TianoCore EDK II exposes server infrastructure to remote code execution.

author: Xbow
text: How did it cost $40,000 in GPT-5.6-sol usage to build a full-chain Chrome exploit? @moyix breaks down exactly where that $40K went.

author: sachin_11004
text: Russian cloud hosting firm Beget said early on Nov 2 its infra was hit by a major cyberattack, which disrupted some services; may have caused access issues for almost 500,000 websites hosted by Beget.

author: QFDNews
text: Patch now: Microsoft warns PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619) and a Brotli flaw (CVE-2026-111497) are actively exploited. Update PHP, .NET, Node.js, PowerShell 7 and Visual Studio, and don't skip the extra restart. QFD can help. https://t.co/9KYRScrdWj #CyberSecurity

author: johnmcclure00
text:
4 Plex Media Server CVEs added to CISA's KEV catalog — all actively exploited. 2 SSRFs, 1 URI injection, 1 path flaw. Scan for shadow Plex on your network. #Cybersecurity

https://t.co/AT1itVn9cH https://t.co/cZY8ppm6n9

author: VECERTRadar
text: Alleged / unconfirmed: actor 'Orcinus orca' advertises a pre-auth RCE zero-day (use-after-free) in the PHP core on underground forums, claimed working on PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. Not confirmed by PHP.

author: DanteMMartin
text: Google caught 'LLMjacking' crews turning stolen cloud creds into $100K/day of fraudulent LLM inference. Rotate your keys.

author: Tychoash
text: The Claude Code Extension Was Trojanized. Here's What 'Anthropic Hacked' Actually Means.

author: leomarshdev
text: langflow 1.0.0 through 1.12.8 has unauthenticated rce and an auth bypass. the public exploit only enumerates mcp tools. that list is a map of what your agents can touch.

author: itsMikeKipruto
text: Iran-linked DarkBlinders operators compromised a government cloud environment in Iraq's Kurdistan Region and a high-profile Israeli security-sector individual. The campaign combines credential phishing, a fake video-meeting app called StarkMeet and a backdoor that uses GitHub.

author: zopdev
text: PHP has released an emergency fix for PHP2Shell, two critical flaws that let attackers take over servers without logging in. Exploit attempts began before the patch was even out.

author: RH_ISAC
text: Cybercriminals are weaponizing the OpenAI API. A new Python-based C2 framework named 'Nik' uses the API to execute system commands and control compromised hosts.

author: Xiba_AI
text: 🚨 CVE-2026-102764 (CVSS 9.3) — BeyondTrust Remote Support, actively exploited. The appliance never checks a message's origin → an unauthenticated attacker reads/writes files on it → web shell → a skeleton key to every endpoint it supports. Patch BT26-05-RS. #infosec #MSP https://t.co/7KVkWT6KOb

author: lyrie_ai
text: Binance, Oct 29: about $6.3B taken. Binance says the entry point was a DevOps engineer's compromised laptop, which reached a service container and submitted unauthorized withdrawals.

author: wahlbang07
text: Two critical Langflow flaws (CVE-2026-93680 and CVE-2026-110186) allow unauthenticated auth bypass and potential RCE. IBM rates both 9.8. Versions through 1.12.8 are affected; 1.13.0 fixes them. No confirmed in-the-wild exploitation so far.

author: zoomeyebot
text: CVE-2026-94300: ISC BIND 9 GSS-TSIG replay can corrupt memory. Critical vulnerability alert.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Still unpatched: Shadowserver tracks 1,000+ exposed GitLab servers open to CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10, exploited per CISA KEV) and 11,300+ open to a second regex RCE, CVE-2026-110264. Fixed in 19.4.2, 19.3.5 and 19.2.8.

author: z4v3n
text: CVE-2026-98432 is a remote unauthenticated use-after-free in the Linux IPv4 TCP handshake (kernels 4.4+). Kernel CNA and Red Hat rate it CVSS 9.8. Can leak kernel memory, crash systems, or enable RCE. Anthropic's AI ...

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: Ivanti Connect Secure: attackers are chaining three flaws to take unauthenticated root on VPN appliances. Ivanti has shipped fixes, and exploitation is confirmed in the wild.

author: zubiqo
text: Nvidia notified customers of a security breach on its Brev cloud platform that may have exposed SSH keys used to access virtual machines. Unauthorized activity ran for 16 days from Oct. 4 to Oct. 20 before Nvidia rotated the keys.

author: davidbombal
text: Copilot Told Researchers How to Hack It: researchers questioned Microsoft Copilot until it revealed a clue that helped uncover CoSnitch (CVE-2026-24301). A specially crafted link could automatically run an attacker's prompt inside Copilot.

author: viccy2025
text: Aider CVE-2026-115726: repo .aider.conf.yml shell RCE, CVSS 8.5. notifications-command / editor auto-load with no trust prompt (<=0.86.2), shell=True.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli; unauthenticated attackers could crash servers, steal data or execute code.

author: itsalreadywhen
text: Ivanti patched two more actively exploited Connect Secure zero-days now in CISA KEV, while a new VOLTA infostealer uses LLMs to triage stolen data.
